newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's new finmin takes on job with optimism.
newsitem.headline: Austria's new finmin takes on job with optimism.

text.p: Austria's finance minister-designate Rudolf Edlinger said on Friday he would tackle what he termed a difficult task with optimism.
"I will dedicate the necessary energy to this tough job. I will take it on with optimism," Edlinger, 56, told Austrian radio in a first reaction to his appointment.
The post, previously occupied by Viktor Klima, became vacant at the weekend when outgoing chancellor Franz Vranitzky named Klima as his successor.
Edlinger's most pressing task will be to make sure that Austria makes the grade for a single European currency.
"I think Edlinger is an excellent choice," Klima said after a meeting with President Thomas Klestil.

Klima will present his full team on Monday and it will be sworn in on Tuesday. No changes are expected in the line-up of the conservative People's Party, which governs in coalition with the dominant Social Democrats.
